about: SDK 18's patterns in the real game: two weapon patterns on every weapon taking paints, Pelican, hellpod, exosuit and FRV skins, their deltas, collections and package map, the Armory's Pattern tab and Ship Management captured (tests/in-game/README.md).

checks.name: a default base and a taken name are refused
the weapon patterns' base sets material LUTs (a paint sets no pattern_lut; its deltas were copied)
the unit patterns' bases set textures on their collections
no pattern is refused once the game has its tables
checks.absent_regex: add_pattern\(hellforge/pattern_probe/(arctic_copy|magenta|pelican|hellpod|exosuit|frv)\): (its base is|its id is a game|its key|too late|collection [0-9]+ has)

checks.name: the copies go into the entity deltas
checks.regex: attachments: [0-9]+ attachment\(s\) and pattern\(s\) added to the entity deltas

checks.name: the unit skins join their collections
checks.regex: patterns: collection [0-9]+ shows [12][0-9] skin\(s\), [0-9]+ of mods

checks.name: every pattern is mapped to its base's package
checks.regex: patterns: [1-9][0-9]* pattern\(s\) mapped to their base's package

checks.name: the pattern lookups are the reviewed ones
checks.absent: patterns: the game's skin or package lookup is not the reviewed one
